## Who needs what result?

Describe the person or maintainer, their action, and what should become easier.

## Current behavior and proposed change

Name the relevant view, source owner or documentation. Include a concrete example and any trade-off worth discussing.

## Useful evidence

What observation would show the change works? Keep the proposal proportional; implementation details can follow discussion.
